en: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur'an] down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein
by permission of their Lord for every matter.
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
